description: Add quick actions for sidebar-listed windows: rename the selected/current window and assign a highlight color. Keep window names stable while the sidebar is running by disabling both tmux automatic renaming and application-driven rename changes, so manual names do not get replaced with command names like bash. Expose a vim-style rename action from the sidebar with `r`, using a popup editor flow rather than the bottom command prompt so the sidebar stays in focus after the action. The rename popup should start with an empty buffer, be comfortable for normal text entry, and support `Esc` and `M-q` as abort. Sidebar rendering should show custom colors in the window list and preserve readable Nord defaults when no color is set. Acceptance: user can rename a window quickly from the sidebar, manually named windows stay named, and the sidebar can later be extended with color controls.
title: Add tmux sidebar window rename and color controls
